newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down amid selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks tumbled more than three percent at close on Tuesday after most shares fell on selling pressure, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 99.90 points or 3.01 percent at 3217.67. Turnover slumped to 50.1 million taka from Monday's 178.6 million. Of 96 traded issues, 89 lost and seven gained. Brokers attributed the bearish trend to fund shortage, which resulted from betting on IPOs.
"Small investors are still selling to apply for IPOs," said one broker. Apex Foods lost 846.91 taka to 16,091.24 and Beximco Pharma shed 23.01 to 437.16.
